operation.description: create: a new item, refused if its id exists in the partition. upsert: create, or replace the whole item with that id. replace: the whole existing item. patch: change some properties of an existing item. delete: remove an existing item.

id.description: The item's id: needed for replace, patch and delete; create and upsert take the item's own id.

partitionKey.description: The item's partition key value, such as "c-42" (an array of values for a hierarchical key). It must match the item's value at the container's partition key path.

item.description: create, upsert and replace: the whole item as JSON, with its id. A person approves the exact body.

path.description: A JSON Pointer such as /status or /items/0/qty; /tags/- appends to an array.

value.description: The value of add, set and replace, or the number incr adds.

from.description: move only: the path whose value moves.

operations.description: patch: up to ten operations of Cosmos DB's partial document update, such as [{"op": "set", "path": "/status", "value": "paid"}, {"op": "incr", "path": "/version", "value": 1}].

condition.description: patch only: a filter the item must match, or nothing changes, such as FROM c WHERE c.status = 'open'.

ifMatch.description: The item's _etag from cosmosdb_read_item: the change applies only if the item is still that version.

note.description: Why you need this change. Shown to the approver as unverified.
